purpose: Inventory validated completed Codex MCP trials; any_pass is backlog exclusion only, NOT accuracy across revisions/models
selection_policy: Explicit post-fix run prefixes; top-level runs only, excluding API baselines, regraded copies, snapshots and interrupted/unscored full runs

bird.question: Among schools with a school-level SAT excellence rate above 0.3, what is the highest ages-5-17 free-meal eligibility rate?
For locally funded schools whose K-12 minus ages-5-17 enrollment difference exceeds the average such difference among locally funded schools, list each school's directory-listed name and DOC type.
For the five schools with ownership code 66 and the largest K-12 free-or-reduced-price meal counts, give each school's K-12 eligible meal rate rounded to six decimal places.
What is the ratio of merged Unified School District schools in Orange County to merged Elementary School District schools?
What are the mailing street address and name of the school with the seventh-highest recorded average mathematics score?
How many non-charter schools in Los Angeles County have a K-12 free-meal percentage below 0.18%?
Which schools served a grade span of Kindergarten to 9th grade in the county of Los Angeles and what is its Percent (%) Eligible FRPM (Ages 5-17)?
What is the Percent (%) Eligible Free (K-12) in the school administered by an administrator whose first name is Alusine. List the district code of the school.
List the distinct available administrator email addresses for public intermediate/middle schools in San Bernardino city and county, in a unified school district, opened during 2009 or 2010.

I'm comparing three high schools in Alameda County and want to focus on the one with the biggest student body. The schools have these CDS codes: 1751010130583, 1612910137588, and 1611760134270. Which of these three schools has the highest enrollment of students aged 5-17? Please give me the 5-digit NCES school identification number for that school. If two or more of them tie for the highest enrollment, give me the NCES identification number of each tied school.

I'm profiling the High Tech High charter network in San Diego. For charter number 756, what is the average number of SAT test takers per school across all of its schools with a San Diego mailing city? Count every school regardless of operational status, and treat a school with no SAT record as having zero test takers. Round the average to two decimals.

Following up on the SAT participation review: among the currently operating high schools in the district with NCES identification number 0613360 that had no SAT test takers, which one begins serving students at the earliest grade? Please give me each such school's name and grade span served. Note that a high school must actually enroll students through grade 12-offering grade 12 without enrollment doesn't count. A school with no SAT record counts as having zero SAT test takers and should be included; only exclude schools with a positive number of SAT test takers. Compare starting grades as school grades-preschool comes before kindergarten, which comes before grade 1-and use the lowest grade the school actually serves, not just what it offers. If several schools tie at the earliest grade, list them all alphabetically by school name.

I'm profiling schools run directly by the California State Board of Education. Which of those schools has the highest average SAT reading score? If several tie for the highest, give me all of them. For each school, I need its name and its full mailing street address - the complete address, not an abbreviated one. Only include schools the State Board runs directly, and the score must be the school's own result, not a district-wide figure.

I'm trying to verify where a school I was told about is located. It's a high school in Alameda County with Breakfast Provision 2 status, serving grades 9 through 12, and its identification number is 1611920113902. What city is this school in?

I'm reviewing NSLP Provision 2 schools. Can you give me the name and city of every high school (educational instruction level code HS) whose meal-program status is exactly Provision 2 and whose lowest grade served is above ninth grade? One row per school, ordered by school name. Note: only the status named Provision 2 counts-the breakfast and lunch variants are separate statuses and shouldn't be included.

I'm profiling California's statewide benefit charter networks. Among the schools run by a statewide benefit charter network, which single school had the highest number of SAT test takers who scored 1500 or above? Please give me that school's name and its phone number. If several schools tie for the highest count, list every tied school with its phone number.

I'm looking at a directly-funded charter high school in California with CDS code 1611190130609. Could you tell me its average SAT math score and how many students took the SAT there? Just that one school's figures. If the school with that CDS code turns out not to be directly funded, then there's no answer.

I'm looking at SAT participation in Contra Costa County. How many schools in the county had more SAT test takers than the school with CDS code 7618040730051? That school is itself a Contra Costa County school, so I just want the count of schools strictly ahead of it by number of SAT test takers, based on the SAT results snapshot in the data. A single number is all I need.

I'm comparing schools in San Francisco. How many public schools with a San Francisco mailing city had an average total SAT score of at least 1500? Please count only schools whose district type is 'Unified School District', 'High School District', 'Elementary School District', or 'County Office of Education (COE)' - exclude any other district type. I just need the single count of qualifying schools.

What is the lowest grade level at which any school in our district begins serving students? If several schools tie at the lowest grade, just report that single grade level for the whole district. Our district is NCES district ID 0632640.

I'm reviewing administrator coverage across Amador and Madera counties, and I want to see which administrator first names actually cover the most schools. For the two administrator first names whose holders run the most schools across the two counties (ranking names by the number of schools their holders run, with the alphabetically earlier name ranking higher if two names run equally many schools), please give me one row per public school district in those two counties and per those two first names, showing the district name, the first name, and the number of schools in that district run by an administrator with that first name - including every public school district, even ones where that's zero. Every administrator listed for a school counts, not just the first-listed one. A public school district means a unified school district, an elementary school district, a high school district, or a county office of education, and only Amador and Madera counties are in scope.

For the 2014-2015 academic year, what was the average number of enrolled students aged 5 to 17 eligible for free or reduced price meals per Youth Authority school? Count every Youth Authority school regardless of its status (active, closed, or merged), and treat a Youth Authority school with no meal-program record as zero. Please give me just that one number, rounded to two decimal places.

I have a school's CDS code from a separate list of Alameda County schools on Breakfast Provision 2, and I need to confirm which school it is. For the school with CDS code 1612590136051, please give me the school name and the educational instruction level name. This CDS code identifies exactly one school, so return only that school.

I'm looking at the schools that the State Board of Education directly runs or charters. Which individual school among them had the most students score at least 1500 on the SAT? Please give me that school's name and its administrator's email address. If two schools tie on that count, list both.

We're relocating to far Northern California and want to know how far north California's middle schools reach. A middle school means a school serving the middle grades, the level between elementary school and high school — count it as a middle school if either its school type or its school name marks it as serving the middle grades, so a junior high school whose name says 'Middle' counts. Include both open and closed schools. Please tell me which middle school is located furthest north in California, along with its school type (the value of the field named 'School Type'), its school name, and its latitude in degrees. If several middle schools tie for the highest latitude, list all of them.

I'm working on a story about campuses Los Angeles County opened during 2007 and the SAT participation they drew. What was the average number of SAT test takers per school across Los Angeles County schools that opened during 2007 and are run by a school district? Please give me that single number, rounded to two decimals. A few things to keep in mind: a county office of education counts as the school district for the schools it runs; "opened during 2007" means the opening date falls in calendar year 2007; and a school with no SAT record counts as zero test takers.

I'm reviewing charter school funding models and want to compare the directly funded and locally funded charters that are currently in operation. For each of the two funding categories, please give me: (1) the number of charter schools currently in operation, counting only schools the directory lists as active (open), not closed or merged; (2) total 2014-2015 K-12 enrollment; (3) the average percentage of students eligible for free or reduced-price meals, on a 0-100 scale, rounded to two decimals; and (4) the average combined SAT score (reading + math + writing) across schools that have reported scores, rounded to two decimals. Note that schools without SAT results should still count in the school count, enrollment total, and meal-eligibility average. Please give me these figures grouped by funding category.

Among California's state special schools, which one begins enrolling students at the latest grade level? Please give me: the school's name, the earliest grade level covered by its K-12 enrollment, its K-12 enrollment, and how many SAT test takers it had. In the grade-level codes, P means pre-kindergarten and K means kindergarten, and grades progress from pre-kindergarten to kindergarten to grades 1 through 12 — so a school starting at grade 1 starts later than one starting at kindergarten. If a state special school has no SAT record, still consider it a candidate and report it as having 0 SAT test takers. If two schools start at the same grade level, prefer the one with the larger K-12 enrollment; if still tied, the one whose name comes first alphabetically. The data is for the 2014-2015 school year.

I'm putting together a brief on SAT participation among California's larger public schools. How many individual named school sites in the state with a K-12 enrollment over 500 and a highest grade served of 8 or below had no SAT test takers? I just need the school_count, a single whole number. Please count a school as an individual school site with a name - district and county offices of education are not schools. Include every qualifying school site statewide even if it shows no SAT results at all; such a site simply had no test takers. By highest grade served I mean the top grade level the school serves, as a grade number from 1 through 12.

I'm studying charter schools run by county offices of education. Using the K-12 school meal program records, for the charter schools these county offices operate, broken down by charter funding type (directly funded and locally funded only), I'd like to know: how many are currently operating, their total K-12 enrollment, and their total number of FRPM-eligible K-12 students. A school counts as currently operating only if its status is Active. Please give me one row per funding type, with directly funded first.

I'm documenting now-closed California schools whose students performed best on the SAT writing section, and I need the runner-up. Among schools whose status is Closed (not Active, Merged or Pending), and which have an average SAT writing score, can you tell me which school had the second-highest average SAT writing score? By second-highest I mean the best score strictly below the highest – if several schools share that score, please list them all. For each school, give me its name, its own district and county, and its average SAT writing score.

I'm a parent looking at high schools in California, and I want to know how often a school that's still open has no seniors taking the SAT at all. How many currently open public high schools in California had zero students take the SAT? By 'currently open' I mean the school's status is Active, not closed or merged. By 'high school' I mean a school whose educational instruction level is High School. Please count a school that has no SAT record at all as having zero test takers. I just want that one number.

I'm planning a targeted meal-support pilot and want to compare one school against similar schools in our county. The county I mean is the one where Fremont High (CDS code 1612590125716) is located - please identify the county by that CDS code, not by the school name. For that county, please look at all K-12 schools with more than 500 free meals and fewer than 700 FRPM meals, and give me back: the county name; the number of schools; the average free-meal percentage and the average FRPM percentage, both on a 0-100 scale with each school's own percentage rounded to 2 decimals before averaging; the number of charter schools and the number of non-charter schools (charter vs. non-charter per the charter indicator in the frpm data); and the average SAT score, where a school's SAT score is the sum of its three SAT section averages, counted only for schools that actually have SAT records, with no SAT record meaning the school is simply excluded from that average. Please round the reported averages to 2 decimals.

I'm studying the 1980 growth of public schooling in San Diego County. What was the average number of schools per month that opened in San Diego County in 1980 under a school district's jurisdiction? I need just that single number. Please average over all 12 months of 1980 (months with no openings count as zero), and give me the exact average without rounding.

Among California schools whose students have an average SAT Math score above 400, what percentage offer virtual instruction, either exclusively or in part? Please give me a single percentage value rounded to one decimal place.

A parent is asking about a school and could only give me the CDS code 1612590137943. Can you look up that school and give me its name, county, district, and city; its K-12 enrollment; the number of K-12 students eligible for free or reduced price meals and the percentage eligible (report the percentage exactly as it appears, without rounding); and the SAT results - number of test takers, average reading score, average math score, average writing score, and the number of test takers whose total score is at least 1500?

I'm putting together a profile of Alameda County high schools, focusing on economic disadvantage among schools that serve up through 12th grade. Among those schools, can you tell me which one has the highest free meal rate? For each school you identify, give me one line with: the school name, its free meal rate to 4 decimal places, whether it is a charter school (Yes/No/Unknown), the grades it serves, and its SAT performance level (Below Average, Average, Above Average, or No SAT Data). Please use the school's grade span of enrollment from the school directory (the GSserved field of the schools table) both to decide whether it serves up through 12th grade and for the grades-it-serves column-do not use the free-meal program record's Low Grade/High Grade for either. If several schools tie for the highest free meal rate, list every one of them.

Could you pull a full profile for the school with CDS code 7618040113118? I need its name, phone number, website, average SAT reading, math and writing scores, whether it is a charter school, its K-12 enrollment for the 2014-2015 academic year, and the percentage of its students eligible for free or reduced price meals on a 0-100 scale rounded to two decimal places. Alongside that, please find the highest average SAT math score achieved by any active school with at least 10 SAT test takers – if several schools tie for the highest, just give me that single score – and how far below that highest score this school's math score falls.

I'm mapping where exclusively virtual schools are concentrated. For the five counties with the most exclusively virtual schools - if several counties tie with the fifth-highest count, include all of them - please give me for each county: the county name, how many exclusively virtual schools it has, and the name of the exclusively virtual school in that county with the highest average SAT reading score. If several schools tie for the highest average reading score in a county, list each of them. If none of the county's exclusively virtual schools has a reported reading average, show 'None' as the school name.

I'm comparing online-only schooling options. I'd like to know, for Santa Barbara County and for the county that contains the school with CDS code 1100170109835 (which identifies one school), how many exclusive-virtual schools are in each county. Please give me each county's name with its number of exclusive-virtual schools, listing the county with the larger number first, or alphabetically by county name if they tie.

I'm studying how concentrated economic need relates to SAT outcomes in California public schools. Among regular, non-charter schools with more than 100 K-12 students, I'd like two extremes plus one benchmark school: the school with the largest count of FRPM-eligible students, the school with the smallest FRPM share (the proportion of its K-12 enrollment that is FRPM-eligible – smallest by that share, not the raw count), and the school with CDS code 4615150435602 from my notes. If a school answers more than one part, report it once per part, and label each row with which part it answers ('largest FRPM-eligible count', 'smallest FRPM share', or 'the CDS code from my notes', in that order). Include ties. For each school, please give: school name, county, city, full mailing address as four columns (mailing street, mailing city, mailing state, mailing ZIP), website, K-12 enrollment, FRPM-eligible student count, FRPM share, average total SAT score (reading + math + writing) among its SAT takers, percentage of its SAT takers scoring 1500 or more, opening date, and status ('closed' if a closing date is recorded, otherwise 'open'). Nothing else, please.

I'm auditing FRPM enrollment reporting and need to contact some elementary and middle schools. Please list the name and street address of every named school whose K-12 enrollment exceeds its enrollment of students aged 5-17 by more than 30 students, and whose highest grade of enrollment is grade 8 or below. Kindergarten counts as grade 8 or below. Give me one row per school; any order is fine.

I'm auditing high-school-level campuses that draw enrollments beyond their surrounding school-age population. Can you give me a list of schools where the K-12 enrollment exceeds the ages-5-17 enrollment by more than 30, limited to schools whose lowest served grade is grade 9 or a later grade (a school's lowest served grade being the low end of the grade range reported in the same enrollment record as its K-12 and ages-5-17 counts)? For each school, I just need the school name and street address. Please order the results by the school's CDS code, smallest first.

I'm researching where high SAT performance coexists with concentrated poverty, to help target college-access support by county. For the 2014-15 academic year, for each county, how many schools had both a K-12 free-meal eligibility rate above 0.1 and at least one SAT taker scoring 1500 or higher on the school's own SAT record? Please list only counties that have at least one such school, with the county name and the number of its qualifying schools, sorted from most such schools to fewest, and alphabetically by county name when counties tie.

I have a school on file with CDS code 1611430131177. Find the school in the same county as that school whose own SAT record shows the most students scoring at least 1500 (not a district-wide roll-up). If two schools tie on that count, use the one with the smaller CDS code. Send me that school's administrator's first and last name.

I'm working on a story about the largest schools in the state with the worst SAT excellence rates. Among schools where at least 700 students took the SAT, can you find the school with the lowest SAT excellence rate? If several schools tie for the lowest rate, go with the one with the smallest school code. I just need that school's street, city, ZIP code and state so I can visit and request an interview.

I'm planning reviews of Provision 2 meal programs under the NSLP and want to see which cities concentrate magnet schools under that provision. For each city that has at least one, can you give me the number of the city's magnet schools that run a Provision 2 meal program? Use the city where the school is located, not its mailing city. Also, if a school's NSLP entry lists multiple provision types, don't count it as running Provision 2.

I'm preparing a mailing campaign and need a list of public high schools in Los Angeles County that have more than 500 free or reduced-price meal recipients ages 5-17. By public high schools I mean every public high-school category in the meal program report - regular high schools, continuation high schools, and high schools in single-school districts - not just regular ones; middle and junior high schools don't count. For each school, please give me the school name exactly as listed in the school directory, plus the campus (physical) street address - not a mailing or post-office address - along with the city, state and ZIP code, each as a separate field. Schools sharing a name are separate schools, so one row per school. Please sort the list by school name.

I'd like to compare SAT participation across counties in California that run magnet schools under Provision 2 of the National School Lunch Program. For every county with at least one Provision 2 magnet school, can you give me the county name and the total number of SAT test takers from those schools? Please include every such county even if the total is 0, and list them in any order.
List the IDs of borderless card printings for which Card Kingdom lacks a regular-version listing or a foil-version listing.
Which distinct combinations of card name, artist, and promotional-printing flag occur among the printings tied for the most rulings?
What percentage of all card printings have a Simplified Chinese translation? Round to two decimals.
What rules text is printed on Benalish Knight? Return the distinct text as one line.
Among all Story Spotlight card printings, what percentage have a French translation? Round to two decimals.
What are the cards belong to duel deck a? List the ID.
How many distinct white-bordered card printings are banned in at least one play format?
How many distinct card printings with no recorded power value or a variable power expression have at least one ruling mentioning 'triggered ability'?
What percentage of cards with format commander and legal status do not have a content warning?
Among card printings with no recorded power value or a variable power expression, what percentage have a French translation? Round to two decimals.
Among the sets in the block "Ice Age", how many of them have an Italian translation?
What percentage of Coldsnap card printings have both a Card Kingdom regular-product ID and foil-product ID recorded?
Which play format has the most banned card-printing records? Give that format and the distinct names of its banned cards.
I collect promotional printings and play Brawl. How many different creature cards that have a promotional printing can serve as a Brawl commander? I just want a single number back.

I'm cataloguing how the frame styles on Tarmogoyf's printings evolved over time. What is the number of years between the oldest and the newest frame style used on the printings of Tarmogoyf? The span in years is the newer year minus the older year.
How many black-border cards with power 10 or greater are available on Magic: The Gathering Online? I just want a single number.

I have the count of sets with fewer than five translations of their name — now I need the gap in cards to size the translation budget. Can you give me the total number of cards contained in those sets? A few things to keep in mind: 'fewer than five' is strict, so a set with exactly five translations doesn't count. All sets count regardless of type or release (core set, expansion, promotional, online-only, etc.). If two languages have the identical translated name string for a set, that's one translation, not two. And a set's card count should be its full size, including promotional and related supplemental printings.

I'm preparing a multilingual catalog and want to gauge how much localizable content exists per kind of set. For every set type, I need the number of sets of that type that have an officially translated name, and the total number of cards in those sets. Please include every set type in the results, even ones where no set has an officially translated name (show zero for both values in that case), and sort the results alphabetically by set type.

How many rulings were issued for Mishra's Factory on the latest date any ruling for it exists? By "latest date" I mean the most recent calendar date on which any ruling for the card exists, and by Mishra's Factory I mean the card by that name across all of its printings. I only want that count.

Which artist has illustrated the most different creature cards, and how many different creature cards is that? I'd like each artist's name along with their count of different creature cards. If two artists are tied for the most, list both.

I'm putting together a showcase of zero-mana-cost cards. What is the newest frame version used by any card with a converted mana cost of 0? Please give me that frame version value, and the number of cards in the database that use that frame version. The count should cover all cards in the database, not just the zero-cost ones. If several frame versions tie as the newest, give me each of them with its own count.

I'm tracking printings of Tarmogoyf. Of all its printings, which frame version is the newest? Please give me the year that identifies that latest frame version, and the percentage of the card's printings that use it, rounded to two decimal places. The percentage should be over all printings of the card.

I'm building an artifact-heavy Commander deck and want to know the size of the pool of zero-cost cards available to me. How many different cards have a printed mana cost of {0} and are legal in Commander? A card is legal in Commander if its Commander legality entry is marked Legal.

I'm brewing and looking for cards that combine two keyword abilities. How many cards in the collection have both Flying and Cycling? Note that each printing counts as its own card, and a card only counts if it has both keywords.

I'm comparing how mana-cheap Magic: The Gathering sets have become over time. For two sets — the set where Abyssal Horror was first printed, and the most recently released set in the database — I want one row per set with the set name and the percentage of that set's cards that have a mana cost whose converted mana cost is 3 or less, rounded to two decimal places. By "first printed", I mean the set with the earliest release date among the sets Abyssal Horror appears in; if several share that earliest date, use the one whose set code comes first alphabetically. For the most recent set, use the latest release date among all sets; if several share that date, again take the one whose set code comes first alphabetically. By "converted mana cost" I mean the card's mana value, and a card counts as having a mana cost only if a mana cost is printed on it.

How many different cards have ever been printed as a release promotion? I just need a single number, covering all printings across the game's entire history with no time restriction. Note that a prerelease printing is a different promotion type and shouldn't be counted as a release promotion.

I'm cataloguing the Abzan clan's cards and need this: among the cards with the Abzan watermark, which one comes last in its set's numbering - i.e. has the highest collector number? Please give me the card's name, its collector number, and how many foreign-language printings exist for that card. If several Abzan-watermarked cards tie for the highest collector number, list every one of them, each with its own count of foreign-language printings. Count each foreign-language edition record of the card as one printing.

I'm profiling the weak end of the white-bordered printings. How many white-bordered cards have a power less than 3? I just need that single count - only white-bordered cards are in scope, and please don't include anything else in the answer.

I'm putting together a showcase of instant-speed cards from Magic: The Gathering. Which cards in the Dark Ascension set have the Flash keyword and, among those, the highest converted mana cost? Please list just the card names, one row per card, alphabetically by name, and include every card that ties on that highest cost.

I'm preparing localized set icon assets and need to know the foreign-language name coverage of every Magic: The Gathering set released in 2020. For each set released in 2020 (meaning its release date falls within the calendar year 2020), please give me the set's name, its keyrune code, and the number of languages in which the set has an official translated name. Nothing else.

I'm sizing a catalogue page of 2017 sets that were localized for international markets. How many cards were there in total across the Magic: The Gathering sets released in 2017 (between January 1 and December 31, 2017) that have a name in a language other than English? A set counts as localized if its name has a foreign-language translation. Include every card in each qualifying set, counting promotional and related supplemental printings as part of the set. I just need the single total across all qualifying sets, not per-set numbers.

I've already looked at the heavy hitters in duel deck B (the 'b' deck). Now I want to check the light end: how many cards in duel deck B are not available in foil and have attack power below 3? Note that 'below 3' means strictly below 3 — a power of exactly 3 doesn't count.

I'm writing a spotlight piece on card artists, and I need to know: among black-bordered cards that are obtainable on Magic Arena and have a printed power of 10 or greater, which artist illustrated the most of them? Please give me the artist's name and the number of those cards they illustrated. A card counts even if it's also available outside Arena, as long as it can be obtained on Arena. If several artists tie for the most, list every one of them along with that count.

I'm going through my paper collection before sharing it publicly, and I want to check something about the cards Wizards of the Coast has flagged. How many different cards are there that carry a sensitive content warning, are available in paper form, and have never been available on Magic Online (MTGO)? I just need that one count.

Hi! I'm preparing a licensing brief for our Japanese partner about Magic: The Gathering localization coverage. Could you pull a report of every expansion type (core, expansion, promo, etc.), showing for each one how many sets of that type carry a Japanese name entry? A Japanese name entry means the set's name-translations include a Japanese-language entry giving the set's name in Japanese. Please include every expansion type in the report even if none of its sets have such an entry (show 0 for those), and sort the results alphabetically by expansion type. Nothing else needed - just the expansion type and the count.

I'm cataloguing Arena-exclusive illustrated art of big creatures. How many artists have illustrated at least one black-bordered card that is available on Arena but never on Magic Online and has a fixed printed power of at least 5? I want just the number of artists, nothing else. Count across all printings in the collection with no time restriction. Note that a card whose power varies is not a fixed number, so it shouldn't count as power 5 or more.

I collect trading cards, and one of my favorites is Ancestor's Chosen. Of all the sets that include this card, look at the one released most recently - if several sets share that latest release date, consider them together. How many creature cards in that set (or sets) have power greater than toughness? I just want that single count, nothing else.

Among the Commander-leadable cards that the Card Kingdom catalog lists for both a foil printing and a regular non-foil printing – cards listed for only one of the two printings don't count – I want the single most recent card frame year (the latest calendar year among the frame versions), and the count of cards in that group whose frame version is that year. Please return just that one row: the frame year and its card count.

I'm compiling the official rulings archive for the Magic: The Gathering card Fireball. How many official rulings have ever been issued for Fireball? I need the total across all time, with no date restriction.

Which card whose original type is 'Creature - Elf' has received the most rulings, and how many rulings has it received? I want the card name and the number of rulings. A card and all of its printings/reprints count as one and the same card. If several cards tie for the most rulings, list every one of them.

I'm reviewing the very first cards in the database and want to compare how widely accepted white cards are versus black cards across play formats. For each card color that appears among the cards with ID 1 through 20, please tell me the card color and the number of play formats in which cards of that color are legal. A card only counts as legal in a format if its legality status for that format is 'Legal' - banned or restricted doesn't count.

I'm tracking John Avon's artwork. Among his cards that exist as powerful foils, what is the most recent frame year, and how many of those cards carry it? If several years are tied for most recent, give each year with its own count. Match John Avon on the illustrator's name.

I play paper Magic and I'm building a pauper deck. How many printings of cards illustrated by Erica Yang are legal in the pauper format and exist as paper (physically printed) cards? I want just a single count of printings, with each printing counted separately.

I keep a Card Kingdom catalogue and want to list the creature cards that Card Kingdom stocks in both foil and non-foil printings. A card counts as stocked in both printings when both its Card Kingdom Foil id and its Card Kingdom id are present. Please give me one row per card, with each card's Card Kingdom Foil id and Card Kingdom id, and nothing else. For the East Bohemia districts that serve at least one client born in the 1980s (birth years 1980 through 1989), please give me: the average of those districts' average salaries, rounded to two decimal places, and the number of such districts.

I'm planning a card-offer mailing and want to gauge how affluent the home districts of certain clients are. Please give me one number: the average, over the districts where these clients live, of each district's average salary, rounded to two decimal places. The clients are account owners in central Bohemia who hold no credit card for their account. Two things to keep in mind: a client's district is the one recorded with the client, not the district of the account's branch; and a client counts as holding a card for an account if a card is linked to any disposition of that account, not just their own.

I'm preparing for a client review and want to gauge how indebted our older customers' accounts are, including accounts that never took any loans. Could you give me the average number of loans per account among accounts whose owner was born before 1950? By 'born before 1950' I mean a birth date earlier than 1 January 1950, and all loans should count regardless of when they were approved. Please give me the average rounded to two decimal places, and nothing else.

I'm putting together a periodic report on large payments made by a specific customer cohort, split by what the payment was for. Among payments over $4000 (strictly more than $4000) made from the accounts of male customers born between 1974 and 1976, I need two figures: how many were household payments, and how many were made for a purpose other than household payment. A few rules to keep in mind: born between 1974 and 1976 means the birth year is 1974, 1975 or 1976; a customer's accounts are the ones they hold a disposition on; payments are the individual transactions executed on the account, not standing payment orders; a payment counts as other-purpose only if it has a recorded purpose different from household payment, and a payment with no purpose recorded counts in neither bucket.

I want to find out whether our borrowing households from larger population centres transact differently from local ones. For every account at the Prachatice branch that has taken at least one loan, please give me: the account number, the account opening date, the total amount ever borrowed, how many outside bank counterparties the account has transacted with over its entire history, the owner's home district, the population of that district, and a rank of these borrowing households by home-district population from largest to smallest. Note that a counterparty means a particular bank account at another institution, identified by that account number, not by the bank code, and only transfers to or from another bank count — handling cash at our own branch does not involve a counterparty. A household's home district is the district its owner client is registered in, which is not necessarily Prachatice. For the ranking: largest population first, ties share the same rank and the next rank after a tie is skipped, and among households whose home districts have the same population, list the smaller account number first.

I'm profiling our gold-card customers for a regional campaign, split by gender. For women first, then men, look at gold-card holders whose card's account has an average balance over 1,000. Among the branch districts holding those accounts, keep only the districts with over 100,000 inhabitants. For each gender, tell me: the number of those districts; which of them has the most inhabitants, with its inhabitants figure - if two districts tie, list both, one row per district; the average salary across those districts, rounded to two decimals; and the average ratio of urban inhabitants across those districts, rounded to two decimals. Nothing else. Please note: 'over' means strictly greater than, and an account's average balance is the mean of its balances after each transaction.

I'm preparing a partner-bank negotiation and want to focus on our big-city clients. Please tell me, for 1998 (1 January through 31 December 1998), where the money went from gold credit card clients' accounts held at branches in large districts. Specifically: for accounts whose owner has a gold credit card, and whose branch is located in a district with at least 250,000 inhabitants, look at their outgoing payments (debit transactions, type VYDAJ). I need a ranking of the recipient bank and counter-account pairs by the total amount paid. If two pairs tie for the largest total, list both. For each pair, give me: the recipient bank code, the recipient counter-account number, the number of outgoing payments, and the total amount paid.

I'm reviewing what the money leaving our Pisek district branch's accounts is actually used for. What percentage of the total amount of outgoing payments that state a payment purpose went to household bill payments (SIPO)? Please give me a single percentage value, rounded to two decimals. Note this should be based only on payments that state a purpose, not all outgoing payments, and should consider the full transaction history.

I'm planning a regional campaign for female customers who hold a credit card and a loan, and I need a demographic profile per region. For each region, please give me: the region, the average district salary of the districts where these female clients live, and the average 1996 district unemployment rate of those same districts – both averages rounded to 2 decimal places. I also want the name of the most populous district among those districts in each region, so I know where to focus local advertising. A few rules: count only female clients who own the account (disposition type OWNER) and who have at least one credit card and at least one loan on that account. 'Most populous' means the district with the largest number of inhabitants; if two tie, take the one whose name comes first alphabetically. One row per region, and include every region that has at least one such client – nothing else.

I'm reviewing our presence in central Bohemia. Please tell me: the names of the three most populous districts of central Bohemia (largest by inhabitants), the number of crimes committed in 1996 in each of them, the average 1996 crime count across those three districts, the average 1996 crime count across all districts in the country, and the difference between the three-district average and the overall average (three-district average minus overall average). Rank districts by inhabitants, breaking ties by district name alphabetically (ignoring accents). Round all averages and the difference to 2 decimal places. The overall average should cover every district in the country, whether or not it has any accounts.

For planning region-targeted card offers, I need to look at the smallest markets behind each credit card type. For each credit card type (gold, classic and junior), which home district of the clients holding that type has the fewest inhabitants, and how many inhabitants does that district have? Please include all three card types, and if several districts tie for the fewest inhabitants, list them all.

I'm reviewing how our branches performed in 1996, and I'd like a picture of the money standing in accounts opened during that year, across the region that Litomerice belongs to (the region as given in the district table's region field).

For each district in that region where at least one account was opened in 1996 (openings counted by account creation date within the calendar year 1996), please give me:
- the district name,
- the number of accounts opened in 1996,
- the average end-of-1996 balance of those accounts,
with rows ordered by district name.

Also give me:
- the region-wide average end-of-1996 balance, taken across all those accounts (not as the mean of the district averages),
- the district with the highest average end-of-1996 balance; if two districts tie, name the one that comes first alphabetically.

By end-of-1996 balance I mean the balance after the account's last transaction dated on or before 1996-12-31; transactions dated 1997 or later don't count, and if several transactions fall on that last date, the one with the highest transaction id is the one that matters. Please round all averages to two decimals.

I want to check whether our biggest short-term loans cluster in populous branch districts and how well-off those areas are. Looking at 24-month loans on accounts with weekly statement issuance, take the ten largest loans ranked by approved amount from highest to lowest — if two loans have the same amount, the one with the smaller loan id ranks first, and ranking continues consecutively after a tie. The district of a loan is the district where the branch managing the loan account is located. Among the districts those ten loans come from, I need: the district with the most inhabitants (if two districts tie on inhabitants, the one with the smaller district id counts as more populous), that district's number of inhabitants, and the average salary across those districts rounded to two decimals.

For every district with at least 100,000 inhabitants that has withdrawal transactions, can you show me the district name, region, population, total amount withdrawn in the district, withdrawals per inhabitant (rounded to 2 decimals), the district's rank by withdrawals per inhabitant (highest first), and the average standing-order debit per account held in the district (rounded to 2 decimals)? I want to compare withdrawal pressure and the standing-order burden side by side across our major districts. Please rank all qualifying districts, not just the top few, using competition ranking so tied districts share a rank and the next rank is skipped (e.g. 1, 1, 3). The whole transaction history on record is in scope. For the average standing-order debit per account, every account held in the district counts, including ones with no standing orders – those simply bring no debits.

I'm preparing a client review for client 3541. For each account this client can access, I need one row with: the account id, the date the account was opened, its frequency, the name and region of the district where the account is held, whether that district is the client's home district (Yes/No), that district's average salary, the loan repayment status (none if there's no loan), the loan amount (0 if no loan), the number of transactions over the account's whole recorded history, total income, total expense, net balance, the number of clients whose home district lies in that region, the name of the most populous district in that region, that district's number of inhabitants, and the account district's population rank within its region. Order the rows by number of transactions, most first, with ties broken by ascending account id. The client's home district is the district recorded for the client, and population means number of inhabitants. For ranks, the most populous district is rank 1; districts with equal population share a rank and the next rank skips.

I'm doing a lending review by account-opening year for my region. For accounts opened in the central Bohemia region from 1 January 1996 onward, broken down by the calendar year of the account creation date (as a text string like '1996', not an integer), I need: the number of accounts opened that year in the region, the total amount lent on those accounts, and the average across the districts of the amount lent per account opened in that district, rounded to two decimals. An account with no loan counts as having lent nothing.

For a regional risk review, I need to look at our largest 24-month loans. Please find the ten loans with the largest approved amount among loans with a 24-month duration on accounts that have weekly statement issuance. For each of these ten loans, give me: the district of the branch servicing the account, the approved amount, the approval date, and the account balance at the end of the day the loan was approved. Two rules: if two loans have the same approved amount, the one approved earlier counts as larger; and if several transactions share that last day, the one with the higher transaction id counts as the later one. List the results from the largest approved amount down.

I'm putting together a review of our first credit card wave and need a profile of every client who was issued a credit card in 1994 (issue date falling in calendar year 1994). For each such client, please include: client id, gender, birth date, card type, age at card issue (the card's issue year minus the client's birth year), number of loans on their account, total amount borrowed, borrower classification, district name, district average salary, and their age rank within gender. Use these classifications: Young borrower if there's at least one loan on the account and age at card issue is under 30; Mature borrower if there's at least one loan and age at card issue is 30 or more; otherwise Non-borrower. The age rank within gender should be a standard competition rank - equal ages share a rank and the next rank is skipped (e.g. 1, 1, 3). Order the rows by client id.

I'm reviewing branches in the north Moravia region ahead of a client meeting. For each branch there, how many transactions dated on or before 14 October 1998 have no characterization recorded? A branch is the district the account belongs to, and the count should cover all of the branch's accounts' transactions. Please list only the top three branches by this count, with the branch name and its count, ranked first to third. If any branches tie on the count, order them alphabetically by branch name and keep three rows after that ordering.

The loan of 98832 approved on January 3rd, 1996 has one applicant account. For that account, list every counterparty it had paid before January 3rd, 1996. A counterparty means a specific account number at a specific bank, so give me one row per bank code and account number combination. For each counterparty I need the bank code, the account number, the number of outgoing payments made to them, and the total amount paid to them. Count only outgoing payments (VYDAJ, i.e. debits) made before January 3rd, 1996, and sort the counterparties by total amount paid, largest first.

For the year-end review of my branch at location 1: how many accounts that were on the branch's books as of 31 December 1995 hold an active loan contract? I want a single integer, nothing else. An account counts only if it belonged to the branch on that date, and only contracts that are still active by their repayment status count - statuses A and B are finished contracts and shouldn't be included.

I'm closing the 1998 books for client 2823's account and need to reconcile the interest. What was the net interest on that account for calendar year 1998 (1 January through 31 December 1998) – interest credited minus penalty interest charged, with penalty interest entering as negative – as a single exact amount in CZK, not rounded? Please include everything credited or charged over the year; the client's account is one account, regardless of the disposition it carries.

I need to profile our three largest loans held by female clients. Please report for each of these loans: the client id, loan amount, duration in months, total payments, interest paid, loan status, the district and region of the branch where the loan's account is held, the account's transaction count and total deposits, an income category, the number of loans the bank has granted in that region, the average of the average salaries of that region's districts, and the client's completed age on 2026-10-09. A few notes: the three largest loans are the three highest approved loan amounts, and if amounts tie, include all tied loans. Total payments is the monthly payment times the duration, and interest paid is total payments minus the approved amount; round money figures to two decimals. The income category is High Income if total deposits exceed twice the loan amount, Medium Income if they exceed the loan amount, and Low Income otherwise. Loans in a region counts every loan the bank has granted in that region for all clients, not only female clients. The region's average salary is the average of the average salaries of the districts in that region, rounded to two decimals. For the age, use the completed age on 2026-10-09, subtracting one if the birthday hasn't occurred by that date.

I need to find out where our pre-1997 long-term mortgage exposure is concentrated geographically. Long-term means a loan duration of more than 24 months, and "opened before 1997" should exclude anything opened during 1997. Please tell me: for each region, which districts have at least one such account, and give me the region whose qualifying districts have the largest combined number of inhabitants. Along with the region's name, I want the number of those districts in it, their combined population, and the total number of those accounts in the region. If two regions tie on combined population, pick the one whose name comes first alphabetically.

I'm putting together a market-coverage report on how our 1997 rollout of monthly-statement accounts reached large urban districts. For districts with at least 100,000 inhabitants that had at least one monthly-statement account opened during calendar year 1997, please give me: the total number of monthly-statement accounts opened in those districts during 1997, how many districts are involved, and the average salary across these qualifying districts rounded to two decimals.

I'd like to review the breadth of each gold-card account's external payment network. For every account that has a gold credit card, could you list: the account id, the district name and region of the branch, the total amount received, the total amount withdrawn, the number of loans taken, and the number of accounts at other banks that money was transferred to or received from? Then rank the accounts by that number of external counterparties. A few things to keep in mind: if accounts tie on the number, they share a rank and the next rank is not skipped; accounts with no external counterparty transfers should still be included and count as zero; and the totals and counts should cover the full recorded period.

I'm preparing our branch's annual customer review. For every account held at the Tabor branch as of 31 December 1996, I need a one-row profile per account, ordered among tied ranks by ascending account id, showing: the account id; the date the account was opened; the owner's gender and their age at 31 December 1996 in whole completed years; the number of credit cards issued to the account by 31 December 1996 (0 if none); the number of loans approved to the account by 31 December 1996 (0 if none); a loan standing label; the number of transactions on the account during 1997; the total money into the account during 1997; the total money out of the account during 1997; the peak balance reached on the account during 1997 (0 if none); and the account's rank by 1997 peak balance, highest first, with ties sharing a rank and the next rank skipped (e.g. 1, 1, 3). All 'as of' figures are taken at 31 December 1996; activity figures cover the calendar year 1997. A card or loan counts as held if it was issued or approved on or before 31 December 1996. The loan standing label is: 'no loan' if the account had no loans approved by 31 December 1996; otherwise 'defaulted' if any of its loans has repayment status B; otherwise 'repaying' if any has status C or D; otherwise 'paid off'. Money in is the sum of credit transaction amounts; money out is the sum of debit and cash-withdrawal transaction amounts. The account owner is the person with the 'OWNER' disposition on the account; other dispositions are just additional users. Nothing beyond these fields, please.

I'd like a district-by-district picture of where our classic-card-holding account owners send money outside the bank. For every district, give me: the district name, the number of clients who own an account and hold a classic credit card, the number of external accounts at other banks those clients paid through outgoing payments, and the total amount of those outgoing payments. A district means the district of the branch where the owned account is held — not the client's home district — and each client and every outgoing payment from the account they own counts toward that account's branch district. Include every district, even ones with no such clients or no such outgoing payments (show zeros). Use the whole recorded payment history. Order by total amount paid from highest to lowest, and alphabetically by district name when totals tie. Don't round the totals.

I'm planning services for our older female customers. For the clients who are female and were born before 1930, please look at the branches that hold their accounts, and then the districts those branches are located in. What is the average salary of those districts? Round the result to 2 decimal places. Note: born before 1930 means calendar birth dates before 1 January 1930.

I'm preparing a campaign for senior female clients and want a sense of the economic profile of their home districts. Could you tell me the average of the average salaries of the districts where our female clients born before 1950 live? Please give me just that single figure, rounded to two decimal places.

I want to know whether our small, healthy loans are concentrated in richer or poorer districts before we decide where to grow the small-loan business. Please give me one number: the average district salary, rounded to two decimals, across the districts where the accounts holding these loans are located. The cohort is loans with an approved amount below 100,000 that are still running without issues.

I'm studying how client age relates to branch location. For each of two client cohorts, I want the cohort label and the average salary across the districts where the branches holding that cohort's accounts are located, rounded to the nearest whole number. A client's cohort is based on birth date: born 1980 or later is the young cohort, born 1919 or earlier is the old cohort. Note the district of an account is the district of its branch, not the client's home district. Give me one row per cohort, young cohort first. Nothing else.
By what percentage was Paul di Resta's fastest-lap speed in race 853 higher than in race 854? Use the speed in race 854 as the baseline and round to two decimals.
What percentage of Lewis Hamilton's recorded race entries from 2010 onward were not victories? Round to two decimals.
Which driver won the most recorded races? Give their first name, last name, nationality, and highest recorded driver-standings points total.

In the 1988 Australian Grand Prix, by what percentage was the winner's elapsed time shorter than the last full-distance finisher's? Use the last finisher's time as denominator and round to two decimals.
What percentage of Japanese-driver race entries from 2007 through 2009 matched their race winner's recorded lap count? Round to two decimals.

For each year before 1975 with recorded winner times, what was the mean race winner elapsed time in seconds? Round the exact mean to two decimal places; if it is exactly halfway, round away from zero. Order by year.
From 2000 through 2005, what percentage of race results were by drivers born before 1985 who completed more than 50 laps?
Which constructor scored most points from Monaco Grand Prix between 1980 and 2010? List the score, name and nationality of this team.
Who recorded the fastest Q3 qualifying time at Marina Bay Street Circuit in 2008? Give the driver's first and last name.
Which 20 drivers recorded the shortest single lap times in Formula 1 races? Give their full names, shortest lap first.
For each Formula 1 circuit in Italy with recorded laps, give the circuit name and its fastest recorded lap time in minutes:seconds.milliseconds format.

I'm comparing pit stop activity at the newer Grand Prix weekends. Among the 2017 races that were not hosted in 2000, what was the average number of pit stops per race? Please take the average of all of those races and round it to two decimal places.

I'm writing a retrospective on German F1 drivers born between 1971 and 1985, and I'd like to quantify how often each of them reached the final part of qualifying. For every German driver born in 1971 through 1985 inclusive, over their entire career (every race on record), please give me their forename, surname, Wikipedia page link, date of birth, and the number of Q3 times they set. Sort the list from most Q3 times to fewest, and where two drivers have the same number, put the older one (by date of birth) first.

I'm writing a retrospective on the 1995 Japanese Grand Prix and want to highlight how far off the pace the slowest qualifier was. Could you tell me who set the slowest time in the first qualifying session (Q1) of that race? For that driver (or drivers, if two share the same slowest time, please list them all), I'd like their short reference name, nationality, birthday, and their Q1 time. To be clear, I mean the race named 'Japanese Grand Prix' in the 1995 season. Nothing else needed.

For qualifying at the 1995 Japanese Grand Prix, I need the nationality of the driver who set the slowest time in Q1. If two drivers tie for the slowest Q1 time, give me each of their nationalities. I only want the nationality value(s), nothing else.

Who set the fastest time in Q1 at the 1995 Japanese Grand Prix, and what was that time? Please give me the driver's forename and surname, and the Q1 time. By '1995 Japanese Grand Prix' I mean the race of the 1995 season named 'Japanese Grand Prix'. If two drivers tied for the fastest Q1 time, list them all.

For the 2010 Formula 1 season, how many drivers did Lucas di Grassi qualify ahead of? I want a single number: the count of drivers he out-qualified over the whole season. By 'qualify ahead of' I mean recording a better qualifying position than that driver in the same race, with a lower position number being better. The 2010 season means the races held in the year 2010.

I'm writing a recap of the 2017 Italian Grand Prix and want to credit the country of the quickest driver in the second qualifying session. Can you give me the nationality of the driver who set the fastest Q2 lap time in qualifying for the 2017 edition of the Italian Grand Prix? If two or more drivers tied for the fastest Q2 lap time, give me the nationality of each of them. I just need that nationality (or nationalities, in case of a tie), and nothing else.

I'm writing an article about the Italian Grand Prix and want to know which first names recur among the drivers who finished second in that race. For every forename carried by two or more runners-up of the Italian Grand Prix across all its editions in the data, please give me one row with the forename and the number of runners-up who carried it. Order the rows from the most runners-up to the fewest, and alphabetically by forename when two forenames are tied. Leave out any forename held by only one runner-up.

Who won the 2017 Azerbaijan Grand Prix? I'd like the winner's forename and surname, the local clock time (hours:minutes:seconds.milliseconds) at the circuit at which he crossed the finish line, and the url of his information page, so I can compare the moment the race ended with the TV coverage.

For the 2017 Italian Grand Prix, I'd like to identify the drivers who completed the second qualifying session (Q2) but were knocked out and did not reach Q3. Please list every such driver - no ranking, cutoff or tie-break, just all of them - showing each driver's reference name, nationality and birthday, and nothing else.

For the 2017 Italian Grand Prix qualifying, what is the nationality of the driver with the second fastest Q2 time? Only drivers who took part in Q2 count, and by second fastest I mean the second smallest Q2 time. If several drivers share that time, list each of their nationalities.
For qualifying at the 2017 Italian Grand Prix, how many drivers set a time in the second qualifying session (Q2) faster than 1:40.000? I just need the count of drivers as a single number.

I'm reviewing the longest service pauses in races across the sport's whole history. Which racetrack saw the longest single pit stop ever? Please give me the racetrack name, location, country, the season year of that race, and the pit stop length. Consider all seasons in the data, and if several pit stops tie for the longest, give me one row for each of them.

I'm researching the generation of drivers born in the 1980s and want to know how much final-session qualifying that generation actually did as a whole cohort. How many Q3 lap times did a driver born between 1981 and 1991 set on average? Count every driver born in that period in the average, including any who never set a Q3 lap time. Please give me the average rounded to two decimal places.

I'm profiling drivers whose first name alone doesn't identify them. Across all races in the dataset throughout Formula 1 history, how many qualifying 1 times slower than two minutes were set by drivers who share their first name with at least one other driver and who have no code? I want just that single count.

I'm checking how much of the championship points for drivers named Robert came from races covered by the lap-by-lap timing archive. For every driver whose forename is Robert, I need their reference name and the total points they scored in races where lap-by-lap timing data exists for that driver in that race. The totals should cover all seasons and races on record.

For every edition of the French Grand Prix from the 1990 season through the most recent edition, I'd like to know which drivers set a fastest lap of the race slower than 90 seconds. For each such driver, give me the date of the edition, the driver's forename and surname, and their fastest lap time of that race in m:ss.mmm form. If several drivers in an edition clear that 90-second mark, list one row per driver. If an edition has no driver over 90 seconds, still show the edition with its date, but no driver or lap time. Please order the rows from the earliest edition date to the latest, and within an edition by driver surname alphabetically - if two drivers share the same fastest-lap time, order them by forename alphabetically.

I'm putting together a trivia fact about Italian drivers in Formula 1. Who holds the fastest lap time set in Q3 - the third and final part of qualifying - by an Italian driver, across the sport's entire history? Please give me the driver's forename, surname, and the fastest Q3 lap time exactly as it appears in the data. Only consider drivers who have a Q3 lap time recorded for some race, and if several Italian drivers share the exact same fastest Q3 time, list all of them.

I'm writing a piece on the new generation of British Formula 1 talent. Among British F1 drivers born after 1980, who set the fastest Q3 qualifying time, what was that time, and at which race and in which year was it set? Please give me the driver's full name, the race name, the race year, and the Q3 time. By 'born after 1980' I mean the year of birth is later than 1980. If two qualifying results tie for the fastest Q3 time, I'd like a row for each.

We're writing a piece on F1's younger generation and want a number for it: how many drivers born in 1976 or later (born from 1 January 1976 onwards) have ever set the second-fastest lap of a race at any point in the history covered by the data? I just need the single count of such drivers.

Who set the fastest time in Q3 (the final qualifying session) at the 2017 Italian Grand Prix? Please give me the driver's reference name (the short identifier like 'hamilton') as the result. If two drivers set the same fastest Q3 time, give me both of their reference names.

Can you rank the Italian Formula 1 constructors by career points and give me the three highest-placed ones? For each, I'd like the constructor name, their career points, and their introduction website. Career points means the total of the points the constructor finished each season with (a season being one calendar year of racing). Constructors with no points still count, ranked with 0. If there are ties, they share a rank and the next rank is skipped (so 1, 1, 3), and I'd like every constructor within the top three ranks returned.

I'm writing a piece about how the same common forenames recur across Formula 1 history. Could you tell me how many different drivers named Peter have ever won a Formula 1 race, and the same for drivers named John? Please give me one count per forename, so I can compare the two — if they turn out to be equal, just report both counts side by side. Nothing else needed.

I'm working on a story about qualifying records. Across all races, which driver set the fastest time in Q3 (the final part of qualifying)? I'd like the nationality of that driver - and if more than one driver shares the fastest Q3 time, please give me every such driver's nationality. I don't need anything else, just the nationality or nationalities.

I'm putting together a historical note on constructor nationalities in Formula 1. For each constructor nationality, how many constructors from that nationality have recorded the fastest lap of a race? Please include every nationality in the result, with a count of 0 for nationalities where no constructor has done so. Count a constructor only when it is officially credited with the quickest single lap time in a race's recorded result - don't compute lap times yourself.

I'm studying how pit stop activity changed across the refuelling-rule change for Australia's F1 drivers. For each season from 2002 through 2013, can you give me the total number of pit stops made at the races of that season where, after the race, at least one Australian driver was placed better than 20th in the driver standings? I'd like the season year and the total pit stop count for each season. The pit stop total should cover every driver who pitted at those races, not just the Australian drivers.
For the 1995 season (races held in the calendar year 1995), how many drivers set a Q1 lap time of more than two minutes - i.e., strictly longer than 2:00.000? I just need the number of drivers.

For my monthly recap I need the fastest pit stop made during any F1 race held in September 2016. Please tell me the driver's full name, the pit stop time, the name of the race where it happened, the circuit name, and the circuit location. If two or more pit stops share the fastest time, list each of them with its own driver, race, circuit name and circuit location.

I'm profiling the oldest driver ever to win a Formula 1 race. Please identify the winning driver with the earliest date of birth - if two winning drivers share that birth date, use the one whose full name (forename then surname) comes first alphabetically. For that driver, return his full name (forename then surname), his nationality, the name and date of the first race he won (the earliest date; if two of his wins share that date, the one whose race name comes first alphabetically), and the total number of races he started over his entire career. A win means finishing in position 1 in a race. The career covers every race in the database, from 1950 through 2017. Return a single row.

Across the history of the Canadian Grand Prix, how many runnings of the race have had at least one car retire with an accident? Please note that a crash in which the driver was killed is recorded as its own status and should not count as an accident here. I just need the single number of runnings, nothing else.

For the 2017 Italian Grand Prix, which driver set the second-fastest time in the second qualifying session (Q2), and which constructor did he drive for that weekend? By second-fastest I mean the driver whose Q2 time comes next after the quickest one, counting every driver who took part in that session.
